issue.title: `edit_file` panics on non-ASCII text after punctuation-normalized fuzzy match

steps: Create smart_cjk.md with the exact UTF-8 content 数据 "x" followed by a newline. Read it with read_file.
Use edit_file with fuzz=true on smart_cjk.md, searching for 数据 “x” (curly quotes) and replacing it with 数据 y.
expected: The punctuation-normalized fuzzy edit succeeds or returns a normal tool error without panicking.
defect: After a fuzzy match beginning with multibyte CJK text, a byte cursor advances into a UTF-8 code point and slicing panics.

fault location.explanation: The fuzzy matching loops advance norm_start by one byte rather than by the next UTF-8 character boundary. A following slice can start inside a Chinese character. The upstream fix advances on character boundaries.

Root cause: The fuzzy matching loops advance norm_start by one byte rather than by the next UTF-8 character boundary. A following slice can start inside a Chinese character. The upstream fix advances on character boundaries.

_meta.notes: The exact input is taken from the issue regression fixture. The selected release has an ACP server; no terminal UI operation is required.
